mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT SR.ROLE_KEY FROM sys_role SR LEFT JOIN sys_user_role sur on SR.ID = sur.ROLE_ID LEFT JOIN sys_user su on sur.USER_ID = su.ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND SUR.USER_ID = #{id} AND SR.LOGIC_DEL = false

SELECT DISTINCT R.ID, R.ROLE_NAME, R.ROLE_KEY, R.ORDER_NUM, R.DATA_SCOPE, R.MENU_CHECK_STRICTLY, R.DEPT_CHECK_STRICTLY, R.STATUS, R.LOGIC_DEL, R.CREATE_TIME, R.REMARK FROM sys_role R LEFT JOIN sys_user_role SUR ON R.ID = SUR.ROLE_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_USER U ON SUR.USER_ID = U.ID LEFT JOIN sys_dept D ON U.DEPT_ID = D.ID ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}

SELECT U.ID AS USER_ID, U.USER_NAME, U.NICK_NAME, U.ACCOUNT_STATUS, U.USER_TYPE, U.REMARK as USER_REMARK FROM sys_role R LEFT JOIN sys_user_role sur on R.ID = sur.ROLE_ID LEFT JOIN sys_user U on U.ID = sur.USER_ID ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}

SELECT DISTINCT U.ID, U.USER_NAME, U.NICK_NAME, U.USER_TYPE, U.REMARK FROM sys_user U LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_user stu on U.ID = stu.USER_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND U.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND U.ACCOUNT_STATUS = 1 AND stu.TENANT_ID = #{sysRolePo.tenantId} AND U.ID NOT IN ( SELECT SU.ID FROM SYS_USER SU LEFT JOIN SYS_USER_ROLE SUR ON SU.ID = SUR.USER_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND SUR.ROLE_ID IN (#{sysRolePo.id}))
SELECT M.ID FROM SYS_MENU M LEFT JOIN SYS_ROLE_MENU SRM ON M.ID = SRM.MENU_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND M.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND M.MENU_TYPE = 'B' AND SRM.ROLE_ID = #{roleId}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SYS_ROLE_MENU SRM WHERE SRM.ROLE_ID = #{roleId})
